name: Activepieces
description: Activepieces is an open-source workflow automation platform and Zapier alternative. Flows are built visually from hundreds of integrations, branches, loops, approvals and TypeScript code steps, run on schedules, webhooks or app events, and every integration is also available as an MCP tool.

notes.text: There is no default account: the first sign-up becomes the platform admin and closes sign-up. Anyone who reaches the port can claim it, so create it right after the install.
Code steps are not sandboxed, so anyone who can edit flows can run code in the container. Only give flow access to people you trust.
Webhook and OAuth2 URLs come from AP_FRONTEND_URL in /opt/activepieces_data/.env. Behind a reverse proxy or domain, change it and run systemctl restart activepieces.
